description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for namespace commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides common functionality and properties for commands related to namespaces, such as retrieving the namespace value, resource type, and constructing command payloads.

classes.name: AbstractNamespaceCommand
classes.description: An abstract class providing base implementation for namespace-related commands, encapsulating common properties and methods such as retrieving namespace, resource type, and payload construction.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with this command.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Provides the type prefix for namespace commands.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the namespace as the unique identifier for the command.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Constructs and returns the EntityId object corresponding to the namespace.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for namespace commands.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource, which is empty for this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Indicates that this command falls under the MODIFY category.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the namespace information to the JSON payload using a builder.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including the namespace.
